meta.framing: rolling-origin out-of-sample forecasts; at each origin the model saw only earlier data, and the outcome is now known
meta.intervals: conformalised (Romano et al.). Across all six folds the raw quantile fits covered 81.7-83.3% at a nominal 90%, which under-sizes capacity; after conformalisation they cover 89.8-91.2%
meta.caution: weekly lag-1 autocorrelation on this panel is 0.973, so persistence is a strong point forecast. The model's advantage is in the interval, not the central estimate.
